source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear fission and the fission chain reaction (PDF 140-143, printed 136-139).

blocks.text: Germany ke Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann ne nuclear reactions par kaam karte hue ek hairan-kun daryaft ki. Unhon ne dekha ke jab dheemi raftar (slow) neutrons ²³⁵₉₂U par barsaye jayen to reaction se ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba, ⁹²₃₆Kr aur aust (average) teen neutrons bante hain. Yaad rahe ke krypton aur barium dono ka mass uranium se kam hai. Yeh reaction baqi nuclear reactions se do tarah mukhtalif tha:

Pehla: uranium ka nucleus toot kar taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei banata hai, jab ke doosre nuclear reactions mein reactants aur products ke mass mein zyada farq nahi hota tha. Doosra: is reaction mein bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Fission reaction
blocks.text: Woh reaction jis mein uranium jaisa bhari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot jaye aur saath energy kharij ho, fission reaction kehlata hai.
²³⁵₉₂U ka fission reaction is equation se likha jata hai:

Yahan Q is reaction mein nikalne wali energy hai. Equation ke dono taraf ki kul energy milane se pata chalta hai ke ek uranium nucleus ke fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV energy nikalti hai. Dhyan rahe ke dono taraf mass numbers ka jod (235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3) aur charge numbers ka jod (92 = 56 + 36) barabar hai. Fission Fig. 19.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Fig. 19.1 ka graph fission ko aasani se samjhata hai: periodic table ke darmiyani elements ki binding energy per nucleon sab se zyada hai, aur halke ya bohat bhari elements ki thodi kam; yani halke aur bohat bhare elements ke nucleons utni mazbooti se bandhe nahi hote.

blocks.alt: Aik neutron (1-0-n) uranium nucleus ki taraf; teer ke baad compound nucleus 236-92-U, lamba aur beech se patla; doosre teer ke baad do nuclei, 141-56-Ba aur 92-36-Kr, aur door jate teen neutrons (1-0-n).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.2: fission reaction ka amal (kitab ki Figure 19.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neutron U-235 mein jazb ho kar U-236 compound nucleus banata hai, jo lamba ho kar beech se patla hota aur do tukron, Ba-141 aur Kr-92, mein toot jata hai; saath teen neutrons nikalte hain. Mass numbers barabar: 236 = 141 + 92 + 3; charge numbers barabar: 92 = 56 + 36 + 0.

Maslan uranium ki binding energy per nucleon taqreeban 7.6 MeV hai, aur fission ke products barium aur krypton ki taqreeban 8.5 MeV per nucleon. Is liye jab uranium nucleus barium aur krypton mein toot'ta hai to har nucleon par (8.5 − 7.6) = 0.9 MeV energy nikalti hai. Yani ek uranium nucleus ke fission mein 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV energy nikalti hai.

Uranium ka fission hamesha ek jaise tukde (Ba, Kr) nahi deta. Binding energy graph ke oopar wale seedhe (flat) hisse ka koi bhi jodi nuclei ban sakti hai. Do aur mumkin fission reactions misal ke taur par:

Is tarah uranium ke fission mein kai qisam ke products ban sakte hain, aur yeh sab fission fragments radioactive hote hain. Fission sirf uranium tak mehdood nahi; bohat se doosre bhari elements mein bhi ho sakta hai. Lekin dekha gaya hai ke slow neutrons se fission sab se aasani se uranium-235 aur plutonium-239 mein hota hai, is liye zyada tar yahi do istemal hote hain.

Fission mein uranium-235 ka nucleus ek neutron jazb kar ke taqreeban barabar mass ke do nuclei mein toot'ta hai aur saath do ya teen neutrons bhi nikalta hai. In neutrons ko theek tarah istemal karein to yeh mazeed uranium atoms mein fission karte hain, aur reaction khud ba khud chalta rehta hai. Ise fission chain reaction kehte hain. Farz karein hamare paas ²³⁵₉₂U ki kuch miqdar hai aur kisi source ka ek slow neutron ek uranium atom mein fission karta hai, jis se taqreeban teen neutrons nikalte hain. Halaat munasib hon to yeh mazeed atoms mein fission karte hain. Is tarah amal bohat tezi se barhta hai aur intehai kam waqt mein bohat zyada energy aur zabardast dhamaka paida hota hai. Fig. 19.3 fission chain reaction dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Shakh-dar zanjeer: aik fissile nucleus do fission neutrons do nuclei ko bhejta hai, har aik do mazeed ko (chaar), aur woh aath ko. Har neutron teer par nucleus se pehle chhota nuqta hai. Labels: Fission neutrons, Fissile nuclei.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.3: fission chain reaction (kitab ki Figure 19.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shakal mein har fission do neutrons chhorta hai aur har neutron agla fission karta hai, is liye nuclei 1, 2, 4, 8 ki tarah dugne hote jate hain. Yahi be-qaboo (uncontrolled) chain reaction hai jo atom bomb mein hota hai.

Aise halaat bhi banaye ja sakte hain jin mein ek fission ke tamam neutrons mein se sirf ek neutron agla fission kare; baqi neutrons bahar nikal jayen ya uranium ke ilawa kisi aur cheez mein jazb ho jayen. Tab chain reaction apni shuru wali raftar se hi chalta rehta hai. Fig. 19.4 dekhein: (a) fissile maddah (jaise enriched uranium-235) ki patli chadar mein fission ke neutrons hawa mein bikhar jate hain, is liye chain reaction nahi hota. (b) Kuch behtar halaat hain: pehle fission ke kuch neutrons sirf ek aur fission karte hain, lekin chain reaction phir bhi nahi banta. (c) Zyada tar uranium-235 wala ek gol tukda (spherical lump) hai; agar yeh kafi bara ho to fission ke zyada tar neutrons bahar nikalne se pehle hi jazb ho jate hain aur chain reaction chalta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) 235U ki patli chadar: neutron dakhil hota, fission hota aur neutrons (n) chadar se bahar nikal jate. (b) 235U ka U-shakal tukra: aane wala neutron fission (nuqta) karta; aik neutron doosre baazu mein doosra fission karta aur baqi (n) nikal jate. (c) 235U ka kurra: aane wala neutron fissions (nuqte) shuru karta jin ke neutrons andar mazeed fissions karte; kuch neutrons bahar nikal jate.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: (a) patli chadar, (b) U-shakal tukra, (c) 235U ka kurra (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) Patli chadar mein fission ke neutrons foran bahar nikal jate hain, chain reaction nahi hota. (b) U-shakal mein aik neutron doosra fission karta hai, phir bhi zyada tar neutrons bahar nikal jate hain. (c) Kafi bare kurre mein zyada tar neutrons bahar nikalne se pehle doosre nuclei mein fission karte hain, is liye chain reaction chalta hai. Kitab (c) mein 235 ko neeche (subscript) chhapti hai; sahi 235U (oopar) hai.

blocks.title: Critical mass
blocks.text: Uranium ka woh mass jis mein ek fission ke tamam neutrons mein se ek neutron agla fission kare, critical mass kehlata hai.

Is mass ka hajm (volume) critical volume ya size kehlata hai. Agar uranium ka mass critical mass se bohat zyada ho to chain reaction bohat tezi se chalta hai aur zabardast dhamaka hota hai; atom bomb isi usool par kaam karta hai. Agar mass critical mass se kam ho to chain reaction nahi chalta. Agar mass critical mass ke barabar ho to chain reaction ek hi raftar se chalta rehta hai aur energy ka mustaqil zariya milta hai; atomic reactor mein energy isi usool se li jati hai. Reactor mein chain reaction ko atom bomb ki tarah be-qaboo nahi hone diya jata, balke cadmium ki rods (salakhon) se control kiya jata hai jo reactor mein dali jati hain. Cadmium bohat se neutrons jazb kar sakta hai aur khud unstable ya radioactive nahi banta. Control rods andar dalne se fission ke liye dastiyab neutrons kam ho jate hain, aur is tarah fission reaction control mein rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Controlled chain reaction mein har fission ka aust sirf ek neutron agle nucleus mein fission karta hai. Is liye energy ek mustaqil, controlled raftar se nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: Neutron uranium nucleus se takrata hai. Do neutrons nikalte hain: aik 'Absorbed neutron', doosra agle uranium nucleus tak jata; woh phir aik jazb shuda neutron aur aik aage jane wala deta hai jo teesre nucleus tak pohanchta; teesra bhi aik jazb shuda aur aik aage jane wala neutron deta hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: qaboo shuda chain reaction mein har fission ka ausatan sirf aik neutron agla fission karta hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har fission ke baad sirf aik neutron agle uranium nucleus tak jata hai; baqi neutrons control rods ya doosre maddon mein jazb (absorb) ho jate hain. Is tarah reaction ki raftar barabar rehti aur tawanai mustaqil sharah se milti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 g uranium-235 ke poore fission mein, 200 MeV per fission ke hisaab se, kitni energy nikalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nuclei ki tadaad = (1/235) × 6.02 × 10²³ = 2.56 × 10²¹. Energy = 2.56 × 10²¹ × 200 MeV × 1.6 × 10⁻¹³ J/MeV = 8.2 × 10¹⁰ J. (1 g koyla jalane se sirf taqreeban 3 × 10⁴ J milti hai, yani fission taqreeban 30 lakh guna zyada energy deta hai.)
